question: why did the Edit on token.js keep failing in my rungraph-demo run?
answer: The run itself already diagnosed and fixed this. Four separate write attempts on src/token.js all failed with the identical error — "File has been modified since read, either by the user or by a linter" — and each attempt's old_string carries a different `// synced <timestamp>` line: proof the file was changing between the agent's Read and its Edit. Root cause: token.js wasn't hand-written — it was codegen output, regenerated from token.template.js by scripts/sync-tokens.mjs, and a stray `npm run watch` process was still alive, rewriting it every ~150ms and clobbering it out from under every Edit and Write. The resolution is in the run too: the agent asked before making a structural call, killed the stray watch process, folded token.js back into a plain hand-written file, and deleted the codegen machinery — after which the final Edit and Write completed cleanly and npm test came back green.
label: 4 failed token.js writes + root cause
reason: The repeated 'File has been modified since read' errors on token.js, the stray watch process that caused them, and the turn where the agent diagnosed and fixed it.
